role: PRODUCT FIDELITY MASTER — 6 perfume bottles, one shared industrial-design language

shared_architecture.silhouette: perfect right cylinder — flat top shoulder, straight unbroken sidewall, flat base. No taper, no waist, no facets, no shoulder curve.

proportions.base_puck_thickness: ≈18–22% of body height — a thick solid glass slab at the bottom that bends and re-focuses light

glass.base_puck: solid, acting as a lens: it collects the key light and throws a bright caustic pool on the surface just in front of the bottle
glass.edges: the left and right vertical edges of the cylinder read as dense, saturated, darker bands (total internal reflection); the centre of the bottle reads brighter and more transparent

closure_stack_top_to_bottom: 1. CAP: glossy piano-black cylinder, flat top, height ≈40% of its own diameter
2. BRIM: a wide flat glossy black disc / saucer flange under the cap — the 'top hat' collar, diameter ≈1.7x the cap, razor-thin edge
3. NECK: a short glossy black collar between brim and shoulder
4. SHOULDER RING: a broader glossy black shoulder cover sitting flush on the glass, its lower edge a crisp horizontal line across the bottle
shared_architecture.closure_finish: high-gloss lacquered black — it must carry a long specular streak from the key light down its curve and a sharp mirrored highlight on the flat brim edge

label.shape: square, centred on the sidewall, occupying ≈55% of the bottle width
label.placement: vertical centre of the glass body, dead-centre horizontally, sitting flat against the curved glass so its outer edges bend slightly with the cylinder
label.construction: inset plaque with a thin raised border frame and a fine inner keyline
label.typography: geometric grotesque sans, all caps, generous letter-spacing, product name on 1–2 lines large, sub-descriptor smaller beneath, brand line at the bottom

shared_architecture.no_go: no spray trigger visible, no atomiser collar showing, no plastic seam, no batch code, no cellophane, no box

bottles.name: CAVIAR BERGAMOT
bottles.transparency: TRANSLUCENT-TO-TRANSPARENT — clearer than @image3, reads as tinted water
bottles.juice_colour: pale sky / glacier blue, #A9D3E8 in the upper thin zone, deepening to #6FA9C6 at the base puck
bottles.label_finish: hammered brushed SILVER plaque identical in construction to @image3, hard black lettering
bottles.read: the coolest object in the frame — its cool cast is the only cool note allowed and must be kept small and controlled against the bordeaux ground

bottles.name: SALTY OCEAN BOUQUET
bottles.transparency: TRANSLUCENT — light passes through and colours the shadow, but background detail behind it is diffused rather than crisply readable
bottles.juice_colour: olive-chartreuse green, #B9C36A at the top of the fill, densifying to #7E8A3C through the deepest section
bottles.glass_tint: clear glass, green comes from the juice
bottles.fill_line: high fill, meniscus reads as a bright horizontal lens line
bottles.label_finish: hammered / textured brushed SILVER plaque with visible dimpled orange-peel metal texture, hard black lettering, bright silver border frame
bottles.read: throws a green-tinted transmitted-light pool onto whatever it stands on

bottles.name: LUCE DI TOSCANA
bottles.transparency: FULLY TRANSPARENT — completely see-through; background detail must be visible through the glass, refracted and inverted
bottles.juice_colour: pale champagne / straw yellow, #E8DFC2 in the thin sections deepening to #C9B98A where the light path is longest
bottles.glass_tint: clear, untinted — the colour comes from the liquid only
bottles.fill_line: visible meniscus high in the shoulder; the empty air gap above it is a separate optical zone and must be rendered
bottles.label_finish: warm champagne-gold plaque, smooth satin metal, dark charcoal lettering, thin gold border frame
bottles.read: the lightest and most luminous of the six — it glows when backlit

bottles.name: [TO CONFIRM]
bottles.brand_line: ZARA (same Italian-line shoot as @image3 — white sweep, product code 20110374999)
bottles.transparency: FULLY TRANSPARENT — clear glass, see-through, background refracts through it
bottles.juice_colour: pale champagne-cream, measured #E8DBC3 in the body band, deepening to roughly #C6B69C through the longest light path
bottles.label_finish: warm tonal plaque, dark charcoal lettering (measured label band #5E5E59)
bottles.read: near-twin of @image3 in tone — separate the two by depth and by grounding one and floating the other

bottles.name: [TO CONFIRM]
bottles.brand_line: ZARA (same warm-sweep shoot as @image1 / @image2 / @image6 — product code 20210271999)
bottles.transparency: TRANSLUCENT — glows when backlit, background diffused rather than crisply readable
bottles.juice_colour: warm amber / cognac, measured #A46A2A in the body band; render #C08A46 in the thin upper section deepening to #7A4A18 at the base puck
bottles.glass_tint: clear glass, colour from the juice
bottles.label_finish: brushed silver-grey plaque with dark type (measured label band #B7B3B0)
bottles.read: the warmest object of the six — sits naturally into the bordeaux ground, use it to balance the cool @image1
bottles.instruction: Copy the printed label text letter for letter from the reference.

bottles.name: TERRA PROFONDA
bottles.transparency: SMOKED / SEMI-OPAQUE — you can sense depth and a lit core inside but you cannot see through it; only a rim of light penetrates the edges and the base puck
bottles.juice_colour: dark olive-khaki over smoked gunmetal, #4A4A3A core reading toward #6E7052 where the key rakes across it
bottles.glass_tint: smoke-tinted grey-olive glass — the tint is in the GLASS as well as the liquid
bottles.label_finish: tone-on-tone dark olive plaque, lettering debossed in the same colour as the plaque — deliberately LOW CONTRAST, legible only by the way light catches the relief. Do not brighten it, do not turn it silver.
bottles.read: the anchor / darkest mass of the six; place it where the frame needs weight

source_lighting_of_the_bottle_refs.note: The reference bottles were shot on a light warm-white sweep with a single soft key from upper-front-left and one soft cast shadow to the right. THIS LIGHTING MUST BE DISCARDED.
source_lighting_of_the_bottle_refs.instruction: Re-light every bottle from scratch to match the bordeaux set in @image1. Carry over ONLY geometry, proportion, colour of glass and liquid, closure design, label artwork and label text.

reference_order_note: Indices follow the Higgsfield upload order. Pass medias in this order so @imageN resolves correctly.
